name: CV Builder – Professional Resume Builder SaaS Platform
author: Best WP Developer

sections.description:
🚀 Transform your WordPress site into a PROFITABLE Resume-Building SaaS Platform! Create, customize, and monetize professional resumes — all inside WordPress.

🆓 FREE VERSION — Build, Create & Impress

Start free and turn your website into a modern resume creation platform.
Perfect for freelancers, developers, and agencies helping job seekers stand out.

✨ Free Features:

✅ Premium Template – modern & fully editable
✅ Gutenberg Builder – drag-and-drop simplicity
✅ Instant PDF Export – print-ready resumes
✅ Multi-Language Support – reach global users
✅ SEO Optimized – attract organic traffic

Even the free version gives your site a polished, professional look!

💼 PRO VERSION — Build a Passive Income Business

Upgrade to WP CV Builder Pro (SaaS) and start earning — even while you sleep.

🔥 Pro Features Include:

🎨 26+ Professional Templates (ATS-friendly)
💵 SaaS Monetization (Pay per CV or Subscription)
🛒 WooCommerce Integration (PayPal, Stripe & more)
🤖 AI Resume & Cover Letter Generator (Powered by OpenAI)
✍️ Signature Maker + QR Code + Shareable Resume Link
📊 User Dashboard & Analytics
🔒 Watermark & Template Protection
🌍 Global Multi-Language Support
♾️ Lifetime Updates + Priority Support

🧭 Why This Is The Smartest Business in 2025

AI is eliminating jobs, but it’s creating a massive demand for new resumes.
Every job seeker needs one — you can provide it, profitably.

✔ No Coding Needed
✔ 100% WordPress Ownership
✔ Built for Passive Income
✔ Helps Millions of Job Seekers Worldwide

Your Next Step:
⏳ Each day you wait = missed income.
💼 Launch your own Resume SaaS business today!

🔗 Visit → https://wpcvbuilder.com

⚙️ Installation

🔹 Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “WP CV Builder.”
  3. Click Install Now → Activate.
  4. Go to CV Builder Settings to get started.

🔹 Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/wp-cv-builder/.
  3. Extract the files.
  4. Activate the plugin from Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  5. Configure your options under CV Builder → Settings.

💬 Frequently Asked Questions

❓ What is WP CV Builder SaaS, and how does it work?

It’s your gateway to the resume business!
Users build beautiful resumes using 25+ templates, download instantly, and you earn automatically via PayPal or WooCommerce.

💻 Do I need coding or design skills?

Absolutely NOT!
If you can click, you can earn.
Install, customize, and monetize — no tech wizardry needed.

🌐 Can I use it on multiple websites?

Yes! The Pro version supports unlimited domains — perfect for agencies or entrepreneurs scaling multiple projects.

💰 What payment options are supported?

Seamless PayPal integration out of the box.
More gateways like Stripe are coming soon to boost your conversion potential.

📦 What’s included with my purchase?

Everything you need to succeed:
– The full Pro plugin
– PayPal integration
– All templates
– Marketing resources
– Lifetime updates & VIP support

🕓 Changelog

🏷️ Version 1.1.4

  • 🔧 Minor fixes and performance improvements
  • ⚡ Optimized Gutenberg compatibility

🏷️ Version 1.1.3

  • 🚀 MAJOR UPDATE: Migrated from Elementor → Gutenberg blocks
  • ⚙️ Enhanced block editor integration
  • 🧠 Improved plugin stability and speed

🏷️ Version 1.1.2

  • 🚫 Removed unnecessary admin notices
  • 🐛 Fixed minor bugs

🏷️ Version 1.1.1

  • ⚡ Performance optimizations
  • 🎨 UI enhancements

🏷️ Version 1.1.0

  • 💰 Added full SaaS monetization with PayPal
  • 📊 Added user analytics and marketing tools

🏷️ Version 1.0.2

  • 🐛 Compatibility fixes with themes

🏷️ Version 1.0.1

  • 💫 Improved UX and faster performance

🏷️ Version 1.0.0

  • 🎉 Initial Launch: Core Resume Builder functionality released
  • 👤 Profile & Experience sections
  • 📄 PDF export system added

🔔 Upgrade Notice

Version 1.1.4:
Strongly recommended update for speed, performance, and Gutenberg enhancements.

🙌 Credits

Developed & maintained by BestWPDeveloper
🌐 Website: https://wpcvbuilder.com
📧 Email: support@wpcvbuilder.com

  1. Install WP CV Builder.
  2. Add your templates and pricing model.
  3. Let users create and download resumes.
  4. Collect payments.
  5. Sit back and watch your SaaS grow. 💼
